discoveries.name: Iku, Tapairu, Toa, Mahuta; five unnamed daughters
discoveries.issue: Named records and source-specific relationships authored; five daughters and the immediate parentage of Mahuta remain unnamed in the passage.

discoveries.name: Te-aka-ia-Roe, Te-tangaengae / Te-vaerua, Te-manava-roa
discoveries.issue: Named figures and source-specific relationships authored. The two Te-manava-roa figures remain explicitly distinct.

discoveries.name: Mauike, Ra, Tekea, Ngana
discoveries.issue: Named figures and source-specific relationships authored. The two Te-manava-roa figures remain explicitly distinct.

discoveries.name: Haumea and her named family accounts
discoveries.issue: Immediate Kanaloa, Kane, Papa, Wakea, Ku-hele-i-po and Mapunaia-aala relationships authored. Kumulipo Fifteenth Era spouses and explicit grandson relationships authored without invented intermediate parents. Other named branches remain under review.

discoveries.name: Hina-a-rauriki, Rogo-tumu-here
discoveries.issue: Named records and explicit wife, abductor and rescuer relationships authored.

discoveries.name: Manufili
discoveries.issue: Named carpenter and helper relationship authored.

discoveries.name: Twenty-three Malietoa generations after Savea
discoveries.issue: Source reports count but does not name intermediate generations. No invented parent-child chain to Malietoa Talavou.

discoveries.name: Tarauri’s unnamed brother; Tangiia’s unnamed sister; Lu’s unnamed father
discoveries.issue: Relationships are reported in source descriptions; no fabricated personal names or IDs.

discoveries.name: Liliuokalani Fourteenth Era: Kahiko / Kahikoluamea, Kupulauakehau, Kulaniehu, Koiaakalani, Hina variants; preceding husband/wife table
discoveries.issue: Passage read. Wakea parentage and the identification of the multiple Hina forms still to author. The paired table alone must not be turned into unqualified parent edges.

discoveries.name: Liliuokalani Fifteenth Era: Ole, Pupue, Kamahele, Manaku, Hikohoale, Kahiko, Kaea, Luakahakona, Koulamaikalani, Luanuu, Kawaomaaukele, Kii, Hinakoula, Ulu, Nanaulu, Punuu, Nana, Kapulani, Nanaie, Kahaumokuleia, Nanaielani, Hinakinau, Waikalani, Kekauilani, Kuheleimoana, Mapuuaiaaala, Konohiki, Hakaululena, Waolena, Mahuie, Akalana, Hinaakeahi, four Maui, Kialoa, Kiaakapoko, Pimoe, Mahanauluehu, Hinakeka, Peapea, Moemoe
discoveries.issue: Akalana, Hinaakeahi, four Maui, her brothers and named fishing/battle figures are authored. Other paired ancestors remain unassigned: the quoted sequence is insufficient to infer each intermediate parent edge or identify homonyms.

discoveries.name: Fornander island genealogy: Kuluwaiea, Hinanuiakalana/Hinanuialana, Kaulawahine, Hina, Lua, Walinuu, Keaukanai, Uluhina; personified island births
discoveries.source: Fornander first series (1916), Formation and Origin, chs. I–IV
discoveries.issue: Competing personified island genealogies and alias variations require separate accounts. Passage read; not yet authored.

discoveries.name: Piki, Havea Lolofonua, Maui Loa, Maui Puku; named Tangaloa; Takataka and Lomu genealogies
discoveries.issue: Separate records, group records and selectable competing parentages authored. Maatu, Takataka, Collocott as reported by Gifford, and Lomu are not combined.

discoveries.name: Te-more-tu; Te Anu-matao and four fish-class children; Māori Tinirau; Tui Tokelau
discoveries.issue: Named parent and descendant records and source-specific accounts authored; Tokelauan counterpart added. Six of nine Rua daughters are unnamed in this entry; Rua-te-pupuke, Rua-te-hihiko, Rua-te-mahara still require source-specific identity review.

discoveries.name: Sinaleana, Sina of Manu’a, unnamed king of Manu’a; Ariari; Tubo; Vaka-akau-uli
discoveries.issue: Sinaleana, Sina of Manu’a, Manga, Tavaetele, his daughter Sina, and the alternate Pili/Tuamasanga branch implemented from Turner ch. XXI. Ariari and the Tongan Tubo/Vaka-akau-uli account still under review.

discoveries.name: Tuanui-ka-rere and Tangiia-ka-rere (Atiu eclipse figures)
discoveries.issue: Do not identify these with Tuamotuan Tu-nui-ka-rere or either Tangiia record from name resemblance.

discoveries.name: Disputed Fornander/Lawson cosmogony; Tanaoa, Mutuhei, Atea, Ono, Atanua
discoveries.issue: Descriptions and lifecycle claims now explicitly carry Handy’s authenticity objection. No genealogy or identity is silently deleted.
